title: Multiples of complete sections remain complete
statement: Let C be a small site with topology J, R a sheaf of commutative rings, and K an arbitrary unbounded derived R-module, with derived categories on C and all slices [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For U in C and a,f in R(U), if IsRingedSiteCompleteElement J R K U f [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-complete-element], then IsRingedSiteCompleteElement J R K U (a*f).

proof.text: Use the coefficient-model comparison to turn the hypothesis into vanishing of RHom of the degree-zero fraction coefficient at f. Choose a K-injective representative I of K|U and compute that derived Hom by the ordinary Hom complex.

The existing localization K-flat-model theorem, applied with the zero bounded localization complex, says that the fraction coefficient at f in degree zero is K-flat. Hence Hom(O[1/f][0],I) is K-injective.

The covariant exact derived-Hom functor at the coefficient O[1/a][0] sends the zero inner object to zero. Compute this outer Hom using the K-injective ordinary inner Hom complex, then apply the ordinary Hom-total-tensor currying isomorphism.

The existing fraction-coefficient tensor-product comparison and the degree-zero total-tensor comparison identify the total tensor with O[1/(af)][0]. Compute its derived Hom using I, transport vanishing through these isomorphisms, and return to the sequential coefficient via the first comparison.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0998 and 0996. The Lean proof uses ordinary Hom-total-tensor on K-injective representatives; only the plain coefficient-model comparison remains below it, so no change of derived-category universe is needed.
